description: This file is a PHP script demonstrating the usage of the Smarty templating engine. It sets various configuration options on a Smarty object, assigns several variables (scalars, arrays, and associative arrays), and ultimately displays a template named 'index.tpl'.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: The Smarty class is a PHP templating engine class that manages template rendering, variable assignment, and configuration options.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to be used within the Smarty templates.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the specified template after rendering.
